mapper.select: WITH DietSummaries AS ( SELECT d.diet_date as summaryDate, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'BREAKFAST' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as breakfastCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'LUNCH' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as lunchCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'DINNER' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as dinnerCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'SNACK' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as snackCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'NIGHT' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as nightCalories, SUM(n.calories * d.amount / 100) as totalCalories, SUM(n.protein * d.amount / 100) as totalProtein, SUM(n.fat * d.amount / 100) as totalFat, SUM(n.carbohydrates * d.amount / 100) as totalCarbohydrates FROM diets d JOIN nutrition n ON d.nutrition_id = n.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.diet_date = #{date} GROUP BY d.diet_date ) SELECT NULL as id, #{userId} as userId, summaryDate, breakfastCalories, lunchCalories, dinnerCalories, snackCalories, nightCalories, totalCalories, totalProtein, totalFat, totalCarbohydrates FROM DietSummaries

WITH DietSummaries AS ( SELECT d.diet_date as summaryDate, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'BREAKFAST' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as breakfastCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'LUNCH' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as lunchCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'DINNER' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as dinnerCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'SNACK' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as snackCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'NIGHT' THEN n.calories * d.amount / 100 ELSE 0 END) as nightCalories, SUM(n.calories * d.amount / 100) as totalCalories, SUM(n.protein * d.amount / 100) as totalProtein, SUM(n.fat * d.amount / 100) as totalFat, SUM(n.carbohydrates * d.amount / 100) as totalCarbohydrates FROM diets d JOIN nutrition n ON d.nutrition_id = n.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.diet_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY d.diet_date ) SELECT NULL as id, #{userId} as userId, summaryDate, breakfastCalories, lunchCalories, dinnerCalories, snackCalories, nightCalories, totalCalories, totalProtein, totalFat, totalCarbohydrates FROM DietSummaries ORDER BY summaryDate
